Market today:
The mood is cautious, with strong warnings about an AI 'bubble' from prominent figures like Jim Cramer, despite news of massive potential deals like Nvidia and OpenAI's $250 billion backstop. The real driver is the sustainability of AI valuations and infrastructure funding, directly impacting your tech/chip heavy portfolio.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-49.65%) and SPAL (-56.9%) are your most concerning positions due to massive drawdowns and their leveraged, decaying nature. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. QQQ (-4.55%), QQQI (-6.79%), and SMH (-13.8%) are also flagged as 'SELL' or 'TRIM' and are nearing their respective stop levels.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on how the market reacts to the conflicting AI news – the 'bubble' warnings versus the huge funding talks. Also, monitor your stops for QQQ, QQQI, and SMH very closely.

Bottom line:
Focus intensely on managing risk in your leveraged and underperforming tech positions, especially with the mixed signals around AI valuations.
plays: Consider adjusting SOXL's stop loss from 200 to a more relevant level given its -49.65% loss and leveraged decay.
Review SPAL's stop loss; its -56.9% loss and leveraged nature demand a tighter, more active stop than 21.38.
Respect stops on QQQ (670), QQQI (52), and SMH (540) to prevent further drawdowns in these core tech holdings.
